scope: 4K benchmark observability gate for the period-authentic rooftop receiving assembly, including automatic non-resampled hero/oblique roof crops when real native Unity frames appear. Godot preserved.

implementationReadiness.reason: The evidence pipeline is safer and more observable, but Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runner verification is still unavailable. Readiness is not Visual Fidelity.

visualFidelity.reason: No Assets/QA/Captures4K directory or actual Unity 3840x2160 frames exist on this head. Projection math and source QA are not visual evidence.

work.result: Projects every Renderer.bounds corner of PeriodAuthenticity2000 through the exact hero/oblique 3840x2160 benchmark camera transforms. Save QA requires the assembly to remain in frame, above a minimum pixel footprint, and fully contained by planned 1280x720 100% roof crops. It also installs an AssetPostprocessor that, only after real hero/oblique full-frame PNGs are imported, copies decoded Color32 crop texels 1:1 without scaling/filtering/sharpening and writes a separate UNSCORED evidence manifest.
Machine-readable frame dimensions, camera transforms, projected-pixel thresholds, crop rectangles, non-resampling policy, grazing applicability, critical fails, and no-score-without-render policy.

Persisted quality-scene saves now require period construction/material/LOD QA and benchmark observability QA together, preventing a correct-but-unreviewable rooftop asset from silently entering the scored scene.

verification.method: GitHub source/static inspection plus analytic projection preflight; no Unity runtime was available.
staticChecks: Hero and oblique camera transforms/FOV exactly match the existing QualityBlock4KCapture definitions.
Planned roof crops are 1280x720 at x=1280,y=1440 in both hero and oblique native frames and require 16 px containment margin.
Source QA requires at least 120x240 px projected period bounds in hero and 130x220 px in oblique, while retaining an 8 px full-frame edge margin.
A documented-envelope analytic preflight estimates approximately 164x341 px in hero and 180x313 px in oblique; actual Unity Renderer.bounds remain the authoritative save-time check.

The fixed grazing frame remains mandatory for the overall visual gate but is not used to judge this roofline-specific asset because the existing grazing composition is dedicated to facade/material angular response and ground/contact stability.
Crop extraction is conditional on real full-frame files and writes UNSCORED_REVIEW_REQUIRED; it cannot create or substitute a render.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Period accuracy/scene authenticity: prevents the VHF/UHF infrastructure from being technically present but too small/off-frame to contribute observable era specificity.
Geometry & construction fidelity: dedicated roof crops are sized to inspect ballast-to-rail-to-mast load path, Yagi geometry and coax routing in actual pixels.
Material/PBR physical plausibility: oblique crop makes galvanized angular response and dielectric feed-box/coax behavior reviewable without inventing painted highlights.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: thin antenna elements are guaranteed a reviewable pixel footprint for later shimmer and LOD-pop inspection, but no stability points are awarded before runtime evidence.
Gate integrity: source projection/crop automation is explicitly barred from awarding Visual Fidelity points without real Unity render evidence.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and actual native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing output. When those full frames appear, the new postprocessor should automatically generate the two 100% roof crops; stop speculative expansion and review thin-element aliasing/shimmer, LOD pop, ballast roof contact, cable continuity, interpenetration and galvanized highlights from those real pixels before further additions.
